steps.title:
This is the outside
of your elbow.

Your wrist extensors
attach here.
steps.sub:
They hold your wrist steady
on every crimp.

steps.title:
They work on every hold,
but rarely get trained.
steps.sub: So this spot can get overloaded.

bridge.title:
Train the other side:
your extensors.
